one_liner: Watchlist civic-letter workflow: real scaffold, unproven paid demand and deliverability.

seedPacket.source: Existing project soul created from repo evidence and dispatch registry context [evidence: BUSINESS.md; dispatch registry note]

directive: Use this as the current EIR soul, but do not upgrade authority until operator merge and validation evidence exist.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: dispatch contract text]; see the PR's POM record

sources: apps/api, apps/web, apps/worker, packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma [evidence of implementation]
methods: Compared registry sensitivity to product plan
Separated current code evidence from market assumptions
Built bottom-up market and financial model with every quantitative external claim tagged as assumption

planningMethod: EIR soul upgrade: preserve true repo content, expose contradictions, build validation-first roadmap.

customer.definition: US resident with a specific civic issue who wants researched official-targeted constituent letters [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
customer.primaryPain: Does not know official jurisdiction, citations, or letter format [assumption: customer workflow hypothesis]

market.tam: $136,000,000 [assumption: 10,000,000 paid civic letter jobs x $13.60 average price]
market.som: $4,080 annualized launch SOM [assumption: 25 paid submissions/mo x $13.60 x 12]
market.method: Bottom-up job volume x implemented package pricing; no network data used.

businessModel.unitEconomics: Average price $13.60, variable cost $0.80, gross margin 94.1% [assumption: blended tier and cost model]

revenueAssumptions: 25 paid submissions/mo at launch validation [assumption: break-even proxy]
150 paid submissions/mo in base year ending 2027-12-31 [assumption: ramp model]
500 paid submissions/mo in upside year ending 2028-12-31 [assumption: SEO/referral model]
costAssumptions: $0.80 variable cost per paid submission [assumption: token/email/lookup placeholder]
$300/mo initial fixed operating cost [assumption: lean infrastructure/tooling]
$60,000/yr human review capacity in upside case [assumption: staffing model]
sensitivityTests: Average price $8.00 raises break-even to 42 submissions/mo [assumption: $300 / ($8.00 - $0.80)]
Variable cost $3.00 lowers gross margin to 77.9% [assumption: ($13.60 - $3.00) / $13.60]
Paid conversion 1.0% requires 2,500 qualified visitors/mo for 25 paid submissions/mo [assumption: funnel math]

alternatives: Manual email or phone call [assumption: customer substitute]
Resistbot, Change.org, Quorum/VoterVoice/FiscalNote, LegalZoom [assumption: named competitor set without network verification]

holes: People may not pay for a workflow whose substitute is free [assumption: buyer risk]
Government inbox deliverability may fail [assumption: email risk]
Citation errors can create reputational or legal exposure [assumption: legal/compliance risk]
Local official coverage may be incomplete or expensive [assumption: data risk]
Registry may classify this as personal/research rather than business [evidence: dispatch registry note]
mitigations: Charge real $5/$15/$25 tiers in beta [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]
Use bounce threshold and suppression [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts]
Strip or flag unverified citations [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts]
Keep status needs-revision until operator ruling [evidence: dispatch registry note]
residualRisks: High demand risk until paid conversion is measured
High deliverability risk until live .gov data exists
Medium legal/reputation risk until counsel reviews policies [assumption: counsel need]

strategy: Validate the narrow paid constituent-letter loop before expanding into SEO archive, organization API, certified mail, fax, or community features.

goToMarket.first100: 20 beta prospects and 10 concierge submissions before self-serve launch [assumption: manual validation plan]
channels: Issue-specific SEO after proof [assumption: .planning/GENESIS.md distribution hypothesis]
goToMarket.primaryGate: Paid conversion above 3.0% [assumption: prior planning threshold]

operatorWorkflow: Founder/operator reviews flagged content, failed citations, deliverability exceptions, opt-outs, and refund requests; target under 30 minutes/day [assumption: lean operator design].
constraints: Not legal advice, not claim filing, not lobbying firm [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Political/opinion data requires careful privacy handling [assumption: sensitive data judgment]
WrkPlug client posture is operator-gated [assumption: WrkPlug Phase 0 not yet signed]
Watchlist status until operator confirms business intent [evidence: dispatch registry note]

aiWorkGovernance.allowed: Research, classification, drafting, delivery orchestration, treasury logging [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents]
aiWorkGovernance.controls: Citation verification, moderation, audit logs, operator review, not-legal-advice boundary [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts; apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts; packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma]
aiWorkGovernance.notAllowed: Fabricated citations, legal advice, claim filing, harassment, unverified allegations [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]

unknowns: Whether the operator wants this pitched as a business [evidence: dispatch registry note]
Actual paid conversion [assumption: no production metric]
Actual deliverability to government domains [assumption: no production metric]
Actual local official data coverage and cost [assumption: provider evaluation needed]
Whether WrkPlug replaces direct Clerk/Stripe integrations [assumption: operator-gated]

assumptionLedger.test: Compare first 50 paid checkouts [assumption: validation sample]
Export token, Postmark, and data-provider costs after beta
